title: Apple fixes over 75 security issues with your iPhone and 150+ for Mac, update now
excerpt: Following the release of iOS 26.6, iPadOS 26.6, and related software updates, Apple has detailed a huge number of security...
content_html:
Following the release of iOS 26.6, iPadOS 26.6, and related software updates, Apple has detailed a huge number of security fixes included in today’s new OS versions.

Apple security updates in iOS 26.6 and iPadOS 26.6 impact iPhone and iPad in several ways

Across iOS 26.6 and iPadOS 26.6, Apple details more than 75 security fixes for iPhone and iPad. These fixes cover a broad range of parts of the system.

More precisely, Apple’s advisory contains 78 individual vulnerability entries tied to 87 unique CVE numbers. The CVE count is higher because several entries address more than one CVE.

Apple does not say that any of the vulnerabilities fixed in iOS 26.6 were actively exploited in the wild.

Several of the fixes stand out among Apple’s lengthy list:

  • A MediaRemote flaw could let an app gain root privileges.
  • An AVEVideoEncoder vulnerability could let an app execute arbitrary code with kernel privileges.
  • Vulnerabilities in Game Center and libc could let a malicious app escape its sandbox.
  • A CloudAttestation flaw could let a malicious app bypass code-signing enforcement.
  • An ImageIO vulnerability could lead to arbitrary code execution when processing a maliciously crafted image.
  • Three SceneKit vulnerabilities could lead to arbitrary code execution when processing maliciously crafted files.
  • An Accessibility issue could expose sensitive data through iPhone Mirroring to someone with physical access.
  • A Contacts flaw could let an app add contacts without the user’s permission.

Kernel, WebKit, and Wi-Fi fixes

Apple also fixed more than a dozen kernel vulnerabilities. The potential impacts included corrupting or writing to kernel memory, disclosing kernel memory, bypassing network filters, and causing unexpected system termination.

WebKit received a sizable collection of fixes as well. Those vulnerabilities could expose process memory, reveal whether a user had visited a link, enable interface spoofing, violate iframe sandboxing rules, let an app read files outside its sandbox, or crash Safari.

One additional Wi-Fi vulnerability could allow a nearby attacker to corrupt process memory.

After the 78 documented security fixes, Apple provides a separate “Additional recognition” section with 12 acknowledgments.

Those entries credit researchers for their assistance but are not presented as separate security fixes or assigned additional CVE numbers.

The complete list of fixes and researcher credits is available on Apple’s website.

Security fixes for Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and Apple Vision Pro

Apple’s newly published macOS Tahoe 26.6 security notes list 155 unique CVEs.

In addition to many fixes shared with iPhone and iPad, the Mac update addresses vulnerabilities that could let apps gain root access, escape their sandboxes, bypass Gatekeeper checks or privacy preferences, and access protected data.

Apple also released security updates for older macOS versions today, but those are not included in the counts here.

Apple has also detailed fixes for watchOS 26.6, tvOS 26.6, and visionOS 26.6. Apple’s latest updates address 194 unique CVEs after removing overlap between platforms.

Apple previously shared that it accelerated the released of a number of security fixes for last month’s iOS 26.5.2 release due to AI-powered hacking tools.

content_html_zh:
在发布 iOS 26.6、iPadOS 26.6 和相关软件更新后，Apple 详细介绍了今天新操作系统版本中包含的大量安全修复程序。

iOS 26.6 和 iPadOS 26.6 中的 Apple 安全更新以多种方式影响 iPhone 和 iPad

在 iOS 26.6 和 iPadOS 26.6 中，Apple 详细介绍了针对 iPhone 和 iPad 的超过 75 个安全修复程序。 这些修复涵盖了系统的广泛部分。

更准确地说，Apple 的通报包含 78 个单独的漏洞条目，与 87 个唯一的 CVE 编号相关。 CVE 计数较高，因为多个条目涉及多个 CVE。

苹果并没有表示 iOS 26.6 中修复的任何漏洞都被广泛利用。

在苹果公司的冗长列表中，有几个修复程序脱颖而出：

  • MediaRemote 缺陷可能会让应用程序获得 root 权限。
  • AVEVideoEncoder 漏洞可能会让应用程序以内核权限执行任意代码。
  • Game Center 和 libc 中的漏洞可能会让恶意应用程序逃脱其沙箱。
  • CloudAttestation 缺陷可能会让恶意应用绕过代码签名强制执行。
  • 在处理恶意制作的图像时，ImageIO 漏洞可能会导致任意代码执行。
  • 处理恶意制作的文件时，三个 SceneKit 漏洞可能导致任意代码执行。
  • 可访问性问题可能会通过 iPhone 镜像向具有物理访问权限的人公开敏感数据。
  • 联系人缺陷可能会让应用程序在未经用户许可的情况下添加联系人。

内核、WebKit 和 Wi-Fi 修复

苹果还修复了十多个内核漏洞。 潜在影响包括损坏或写入内核内存、泄露内核内存、绕过网络过滤器以及导致系统意外终止。

WebKit 也收到了大量修复。 这些漏洞可能会暴露进程内存、揭示用户是否访问过链接、启用界面欺骗、违反 iframe 沙箱规则、让应用程序读取其沙箱之外的文件，或者使 Safari 崩溃。

另外一个 Wi-Fi 漏洞可能允许附近的攻击者破坏进程内存。

在 78 个记录的安全修复程序之后，Apple 提供了一个单独的“附加认可”部分，其中包含 12 个致谢。

这些条目归功于研究人员的帮助，但并未作为单独的安全修复程序提供或分配额外的 CVE 编号。

完整的修复列表和研究人员积分可在苹果网站上找到。

Mac、Apple Watch、Apple TV 和 Apple Vision Pro 的安全修复

Apple 新发布的 macOS Tahoe 26.6 安全说明列出了 155 个独特的 CVE。

除了与 iPhone 和 iPad 共享的许多修复之外，Mac 更新还解决了可能让应用程序获得 root 访问权限、逃离沙箱、绕过 Gatekeeper 检查或隐私首选项以及访问受保护数据的漏洞。

苹果今天还发布了旧版 macOS 的安全更新，但这些更新并未包含在此处的统计中。

Apple 还针对 watchOS 26.6、tvOS 26.6 和 VisionOS 26.6 进行了详细修复。 Apple 的最新更新在消除平台之间的重叠后解决了 194 个独特的 CVE。

苹果此前表示，由于人工智能驱动的黑客工具，它加快了上个月发布的 iOS 26.5.2 版本的多项安全修复程序的发布速度。
